name: Converging–Diverging Nozzle · NASA CDV
description: Full 3D faceted circular CDV duct with reservoir inlet and three back-pressure operating points.

expectations.notes: NASA inch-based area law is converted to metres; thermodynamic values are scaled to pt=101325 Pa and Tt=300 K. The 3D wall uses 32 azimuthal sides and 21 axial stations. Compare only after mass flux and pressure become stationary.

sources.title: NASA NPARC: Converging-Diverging Verification Nozzle
sources.notes: Original inch-based area law is converted to metres. Pressure and Mach curves use NASA quasi-1D reference data. The circular boundary is a 32-sided, 21-section CAD approximation.

comparisons.procedure: Use the matching back-pressure preset. Compare area-averaged axial pressure after the mass flux reaches steady state.
